verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a Gmail-based team email client, and multi-channel customer inbox support is a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live-chat conversations arriving in the Shortwave inbox. The AI/MCP integrations (Slack, Zapier) and internal Workspaces chat are adjacent features, not customer channels in the inbox.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
